snippet.title: Fruit Ninja x PAC-MAN | Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Relive the nostalgia – Fruit Ninja x PAC-MAN is here!
 
Jump into four unique game modes, each with a fresh twist on the arcade classic:
🍉 PAC-MAN Event – Navigate the classic maze, reimagined
🍋 Neon Event – Power-up in retro neon
🍒 Glitch Event – Break through wild, glitchy chaos
🍊 Ghosts Event – Catch the ghosts running wild
 
Don’t miss this epic crossover & exclusive rewards – available now!
